name: rawmem
description: Bounded read-only access to a local, append-only evidence ledger.
long_description: rawmem preserves local evidence before interpretation. Its MCP server exposes bounded status, recent-event summaries, and archive metadata without write tools or automatic promotion into long-term memory.

tools.name: rawmem_status
tools.description: Read bounded ledger status and verification metadata.

tools.name: rawmem_recent
tools.description: Read bounded summaries of recent evidence events.

tools.name: rawmem_archives
tools.description: List bounded metadata for sealed archives.

ledger_file.title: rawmem ledger
ledger_file.description: Choose the local append-only rawmem events.jsonl ledger.
